items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: He showed me the swing... But he's the one started me first.

ctx.x: That's right. He's about the, he's about the, I would say, about the hardest working boy that I saw play bass. He's just about the hardest worker. I wouldn't say he the best, but that's the one I prefer. That's the one you like. And I play his own order, him, because he showed me the swing. Yeah. He showed me the swing. I had lots of other teachers and things, but he showed me the swing, he did. Yeah. Now, Lev Newton, he was kind of a, he liked it, he didn't like too much of, you know, too much of swinging too…
